- Synthetic cancellation quote Q1 illustrates a 40-unit refund.
- The cancellation has not been approved or posted.
- The ledger has no refund payment.

Scenario constraint: Use the supplied complete ledger or policy excerpt for the one requested explanation.

Synthetic advisory exercise only. Use supplied evidence; identify missing or conflicting facts. Do not claim to bind, deny, pay, notify, change a system or perform an external action. A human must approve any consequential action.
